result.summary: The environment is highly hostile to pedestrians, characterized by a complete lack of dedicated walkways, crossings, or safety signals. Pedestrians are forced to share a wide, poorly maintained roadway with vehicles under a dark overpass with significant visual obstructions.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There are no sidewalks or protected paths, forcing pedestrians to walk directly in the path of vehicular traffic.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Condition
hazards.description: The roadway surface is severely cracked and uneven, creating tripping hazards and unpredictable vehicle paths.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: The bridge structure and vertical support beams create significant blind spots for both drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the bridge wall

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct raised, ADA-compliant sidewalks to provide physical separation between pedestrians and vehicles.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with pedestrian signals to provide safe, designated crossing points.

interventions.title: Underpass Lighting Improvements
interventions.description: Add high-intensity LED lighting under the bridge structure to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility.

result.summary: The environment is an industrial area with incomplete pedestrian infrastructure and significantly degraded pavement. There are no marked crosswalks or clear pedestrian signals, creating a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no designated or protected space to cross the wide roadway.

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt creates tripping hazards for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Incomplete sidewalk network
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right appears to terminate or be blocked by construction, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion and Repair
interventions.description: Complete the sidewalk network and repair the degraded pavement to provide a continuous, accessible path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically for the sidewalk and crossing areas to improve visibility at night.

result.summary: The environment is highly industrial with minimal pedestrian infrastructure, lacking marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. The pavement is in poor condition with significant cracking, and the wide, unmarked intersection creates a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: No painted markings to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to crossing locations.

hazards.name: Poor Pavement Quality
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces create trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and center of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated signals for pedestrians to safely time their crossing at a signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light pole on the right

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that provide clear timing for pedestrians to cross safely at the signalized intersection.

interventions.title: Pavement Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to remove cracks and uneven patches, improving accessibility and safety.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals despite being controlled by traffic lights. The environment is dominated by industrial features like a large overpass and high stone walls, which may limit visibility and create a hostile walking environment.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no painted markings to indicate where pedestrians should cross the wide roadway at this signalized intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground and mid-ground.

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The intersection lacks dedicated walk/don't walk indicators, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals.
hazards.location_in_image: At the overhead traffic light locations.

hazards.name: Sidewalk obstruction and debris
hazards.description: The right side of the road lacks a clear, paved walkway and is obstructed by construction barrels and debris.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image near the overpass structure.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Paint continental or ladder-style crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: Add Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that provide clear timing for pedestrians to cross safely and predictably.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten crossing distance and improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.
